messages:
Alex - AE: Heads-up — Acme POC is hitting structured output failures when we enable function-calling + JSON mode. They want this for their order-extraction flow. Can we swarm briefly? @Priya @Jordan
Priya - Solutions: On it. Can you paste the exact error and the request body? also need to know which model variant they're using (redwood-1-large / quantized)
Acme - Eng: Here's the client log, pasted (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z ERROR parse_response: JSON parse error: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 234
Request: POST /v1/generate
Body: {"input":"extract order","json_mode":true,"function_call":{"name":"create_order"}}
Response snippet: "{\"order_id\": \"12345\",}"
```
Acme - Eng: We also saw intermittent 429s earlier: `HTTP 429 - rate limit exceeded` around the same time window.
Jordan - Eng: Thanks. Preliminary notes: the response has a trailing comma in the generated JSON (that's the parse error). Two typical causes — (1) model produced invalid JSON because `json_mode` isn't enforced at generation layer, or (2) function_call was involved and the model returned both text+function payload. Need the raw full response payload (not the client-side parsed one).
Jordan - Eng: Also ask them which `function_call` setting they sent. If they used `function_call: 'none'` + `json_mode: true` we sometimes see model trying to produce text and occasional trailing commas. If `function_call: 'auto'` the runtime should synthesize a single function payload.
Priya - Solutions: Quick troubleshooting steps to push to the customer: 1) Attach `X-Redwood-Structured: enforce` header to force structured output mode, 2) Set `function_call.name` explicitly to `create_order` (avoid auto) for deterministic output, 3) Retry with `max_tokens` increased by 32 to avoid truncation.
Alex - AE: Also they asked about pricing impact if we recommend switching to explicit function calls for production — will that change billing?
Priya - Solutions: Pricing note: hosted billing is token-based for generation/embeddings. Function-calling payloads are just token usage; no extra per-call surcharge. If they add lots of external webhooks we should note potential egress/network costs but that's outside Redwood billing. I'll confirm with finance if they want a written note for the contract.
Jordan - Eng: Two more technical items: a) client should set `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` and `Accept: application/json` — some SDKs omit charset and cause downstream parsing quirks. b) For the 429s, implement idempotent retries with exponential backoff and add `Idempotency-Key` header to dedupe. Example backoff pseudocode: `sleep = base * 2**attempt + jitter`
Acme - Eng: We can try the headers and explicit function name. One question: is there any server-side sanitization we can enable to strip trailing commas automatically?
Jordan - Eng: We don't auto-sanitize by default because that can mask model regressions. BUT we have a transient mitigation: enable `structured_output.strict = false` which tries a tolerant JSON parse and will fix minor issues like trailing commas. It's off by default. Use only for POC. Config snippet:
```
{ "structured_output": { "mode": "json", "strict": false, "schema_hash": "sha256:..." } }
```
Priya - Solutions: Security check — Acme's InfoSec asked for SOC2 and data retention answers. @Lena can you drop the FAQ link and advise what we can share for a POC?
Lena - InfoSec: Share the SOC2 summary + our data retention defaults doc. For POC: we can enable short retention (7 days) and redact PII as requested. I'll send an email template to Alex to share. Also note: if they want Dedicated/Private for prod, that's a separate contract and will resolve most of the questionnaire concerns.
Acme - Eng: After trying `structured_output.strict=false` + explicit `function_call.name` we still got a parse fail once, but far less frequent. We'll run a 1k request soak overnight and report back. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Jordan - Eng: If it re-occurs, please attach the raw base64 response payload or `curl -v` output. If you can reproduce, add `?debug=full` param to the SDK to capture the exact wire payload.
sre-bot: Created support ticket #SUP-2026-334 and linked this thread. Assigned: Jordan, Priya.
Alex - AE: Great. I'll update Acme on pricing/retention and ping finance + contracts for the quote. If the soak looks stable we'll start scoping Dedicated next week. :thumbsup:
